# Alibaba Token Plan (China)

Use `alibaba-token-plan-cn/<model>` with VoltAgent's model router.

## Quick start

```ts
import { Agent } from "@voltagent/core";

const agent = new Agent({
  name: "alibaba-token-plan-cn-agent",
  instructions: "You are a helpful assistant",
  model: "alibaba-token-plan-cn/MiniMax-M2.5",
});
```

## Environment variables

- `ALIBABA_TOKEN_PLAN_API_KEY`

## Provider package

`@ai-sdk/openai-compatible`

This provider uses the OpenAI-compatible adapter.

## Default base URL

`https://token-plan.cn-beijing.maas.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1`

You can override the base URL by setting `ALIBABA_TOKEN_PLAN_CN_BASE_URL`.

- https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/model-studio/token-plan-overview
